# Abin Vinod — Portfolio & Digital Marketing Platform

> Abin Vinod is a premier Digital Marketer, SEO Specialist, and Growth Strategist based in Kerala, India. This website showcases performance marketing, local SEO, technical SEO, e-commerce growth strategies, location hubs, and business consulting services.

## Metadata & Contact
- **Website**: https://abinvinod.in
- **Repository**: https://github.com/Dingan2218/abinvinod

- **Email**: itsme@abinvinod.in
- **LinkedIn**: https://www.linkedin.com/in/abinvinod-aby/
- **Primary Tech Stack**: Native HTML5, CSS3, ES6+ Vanilla JavaScript

## Main Site Sections
- [Home Page](https://abinvinod.in/): Abin Vinod portfolio landing page featuring services summary, client proof, case study previews, and contact options.
- [About Abin Vinod](https://abinvinod.in/about): Detailed background, experience, methodology, and digital marketing philosophy.
- [Services Hub](https://abinvinod.in/services): Complete overview of digital marketing, SEO, PPC, content, and web development services.
- [Portfolio](https://abinvinod.in/portfolio): Portfolio of completed projects, client campaigns, and digital growth results.
- [Case Studies](https://abinvinod.in/case-studies): In-depth performance case studies covering SEO traffic growth, local search domination, and Google Ads ROI.
- [Pricing](https://abinvinod.in/pricing): Transparent service packages for SEO, Meta Ads, PPC, and full-funnel digital strategy.
- [Contact](https://abinvinod.in/contact): Consultation request form, location details, and direct contact methods.
- [FAQ](https://abinvinod.in/faq): Frequently asked questions on digital marketing retainer models, timelines, SEO ROI, and project scopes.
- [Blog](https://abinvinod.in/blog): Actionable articles, industry guides, and tutorial posts on digital marketing, local SEO, PPC, and CRO.

- [SEO Services](https://abinvinod.in/services/seo-services): End-to-end organic search engine optimization and keyword ranking strategies.
- [Local SEO Services](https://abinvinod.in/services/local-seo): Google Business Profile management and local map pack optimization for businesses across Kerala.
- [Technical SEO](https://abinvinod.in/services/technical-seo): Site speed optimization, structured data schema, crawlability, and mobile performance fixes.
- [Google Ads / PPC](https://abinvinod.in/services/google-ads): High-conversion Google Search, Display, and Shopping campaign management.
- [Meta Ads](https://abinvinod.in/services/meta-ads): Facebook & Instagram lead generation and e-commerce social advertising.
- [Social Media Marketing](https://abinvinod.in/services/social-media-marketing): Organic social strategy, content calendars, and brand engagement.
- [Content Marketing](https://abinvinod.in/services/content-marketing): Strategic content planning, copywriting, and search-optimized blogging.
- [Website Development](https://abinvinod.in/services/website-development): Responsive, high-converting, lightning-fast web design and landing page development.
